message.content:
Repo: /home/mudathir/all/cvc5/mudathir (cvc5 SMT solver, branch lazy).
Goal: in src/theory/arith/liastar/liastar_extension.cpp, replace the per-lambda incremental
subsolver with enumeration in the MAIN solver: fresh integer skolems y for the lambda's bound
variables, a boolean guard skolem h (decision variable, phase-preferred true), lemmas
h => base(y) and h => not(D_i(y)) sent via TheoryArith's InferenceManager, the next cell read
from the main solver's candidate arithmetic model, and completeness detected when h is forced
false at decision level 0. Answer the specific questions for your assigned area with exact
signatures and file:line references. Return raw facts, not prose essays.
Area: src/theory/inference_id.h and inference_id.cpp. Questions:
1. List the existing ARITH_LIA_STAR_* enum values with exact lines in both files.
2. Show exactly what must be added to introduce a new id ARITH_LIA_STAR_ENUM (enum entry placement
   and the switch/case or name table entry in the .cpp).

input.description: Find toString signature and enum declaration lines

facts: Existing ARITH_LIA_STAR_* enum values in /home/mudathir/all/cvc5/mudathir/src/theory/inference_id.h (inside 'enum class InferenceId' declared at inference_id.h:38, in the arith theory section): ARITH_LIA_STAR_EXISTS at line 206 (comment line 205: '// lia star reduction lemma'), ARITH_LIA_STAR_NONNEGATIVE at line 208 (comment line 207: '// lia star nonnegative constraints'), ARITH_LIA_STAR_SPLIT at line 210 (comment line 209: '// lia star split lemma'). The next line 211 is the comment '//-------------------- ff inference' followed by line 212 '// ---------------------------------- end arith theory'.

Existing ARITH_LIA_STAR_* entries in /home/mudathir/all/cvc5/mudathir/src/theory/inference_id.cpp, inside 'const char* toString(InferenceId i)' (function starts at inference_id.cpp:25; it is a switch on i returning string literals, no name table): line 137 'case InferenceId::ARITH_LIA_STAR_EXISTS: return "ARITH_LIA_STAR_EXISTS";', lines 138-139 'case InferenceId::ARITH_LIA_STAR_NONNEGATIVE:\n      return "ARITH_LIA_STAR_NONNEGATIVE";', line 140 'case InferenceId::ARITH_LIA_STAR_SPLIT: return "ARITH_LIA_STAR_SPLIT";'. The next case at line 141 is 'case InferenceId::FF_LEMMA: return "FF_LEMMA";'.

To add ARITH_LIA_STAR_ENUM in inference_id.h: insert after line 210 (after 'ARITH_LIA_STAR_SPLIT,' and before the '//-------------------- ff inference' comment at line 211) the two lines:
  // lia star enumeration lemma (guard implies base/exclusion constraints on skolems)
  ARITH_LIA_STAR_ENUM,
Enum entries use a two-space indent and trailing comma, each preceded by a '//' comment, matching the surrounding style.

To add ARITH_LIA_STAR_ENUM in inference_id.cpp: insert after line 140 (after the ARITH_LIA_STAR_SPLIT case, before the FF_LEMMA case at line 141) inside toString(InferenceId i):\n    case InferenceId::ARITH_LIA_STAR_ENUM: return "ARITH_LIA_STAR_ENUM";\nCase lines use 4-space indent; single-line form fits within 80 cols (the file wraps onto a second line with 6-space-indented return only when the one-line form would exceed 80 chars, as done for ARITH_LIA_STAR_NONNEGATIVE).

No other registration is needed: operator<< at inference_id.cpp:621 ('std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& out, InferenceId i)') just calls toString, and the switch in toString has a 'default: return "?";' fallthrough pattern, so only the .h enum entry and the one .cpp case line are required. There is no separate name table, macro list, or statistics registration file for InferenceId.

Declarations in inference_id.h: 'const char* toString(InferenceId i);' at inference_id.h:1053 and 'std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& out, InferenceId i);' at inference_id.h:1062 — unchanged by adding a new id.
signatures: const char* toString(InferenceId i);  // declared inference_id.h:1053, defined inference_id.cpp:25
std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& out, InferenceId i);  // declared inference_id.h:1062, defined inference_id.cpp:621
caveats: Line numbers are from the current working tree on branch 'lazy' (commit 574ed99b54 plus any uncommitted state); they will shift if other edits to these files land first.

Enum ordering matters only for grouping/readability (toString is a switch, not an indexed table), but the new entry should stay inside the arith section (before line 212 '// ---------------------------------- end arith theory') so per-theory grouping conventions hold.

I did not verify whether the proof post-processor or any annotation checker (e.g., proof rule THEORY_INFERENCE / trust ids) special-cases specific InferenceId values; standard practice in this codebase is that new ids need no extra wiring, but if lemmas are sent with proofs enabled, the id is only used as an annotation.
